comment: POSTGAME.md P4b, Roland between engagements. He leaves at the tower door as published, with nothing on, and the door is then its own page without the departure; after the ending he is back at his table, walked up to, with a new pitch, and rejoins on SW_KNOWN at his own level, in his own shield and shirt out of the bag and with no sword; struck off and back; at the tower door nobody calls him - once - and he goes up with you to Grimspite's kettle; the sword out of Carn Drey drawn after he left is kept at the door and worn; ROL-3's card started with him; ROL-5 told after the ending - it has ended, he hears how, and the question stays open - with Mrs Dewhirst after; his pitch had Maud told him first; and ROL-4's mark with the sword handed back, Hob's refit, and HOB-3's hammer on the floor.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._gold = $gameParty.gold(); window._lines = []; }; window._mark(); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s)); window._pick = undefined; const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { return sc.call(this, c, window._pick === undefined ? d : window._pick, k); }; window._kit = () => $gameActors.actor(10).equips().map(e => e ? e.id : 0); window._in = () => $gameParty.members().some(a => a.actorId() === 10)

steps.label: Roland's own kit: the practice sword, the kite shield, the chain shirt

steps.check: [$gameSwitches.value(21), window._in(), window._has('I have to be somewhere.'), $gameMap.mapId()]
steps.label: at the tower door he leaves, as published
with nothing on: his kit is in the party's bag, with Fairweather's Own
the door's own page now, without the departure

steps.check: [window._has('The Obligatory Tower.'), window._has('I have to be somewhere.'), window._has('stops walking, out of')]
steps.label: and the door is the door, before the ending as after
after the ending he is back at his table
walked up to his table

steps.check: [window._has('Finished? Marvellous.'), window._has('Is it nice?'), window._has('I left both of'), window._has('Miss Penhallow'), window._has('rejoined the party!')]
steps.label: the new pitch, and he rejoins
at his own level, wearing his own shield and shirt out of the bag, and no sword
SW_ROLAND_BACK on, SW_ROLAND_GONE still on, and his chair empty

and back again, still dressed
still on the map

at the top, with Grimspite in his chair

once
still on the map
